answer: Because the inlet deposit is held in the vine escrow, the oasis audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 70 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
